title: QA Engineer
descriptionText:
About ServiceUp:

ServiceUp is reimagining a $200B+ industry with AI-powered orchestration for fleet and insurance vehicle repair. We’re the all-in-one platform bringing modern efficiency to a complex market. We’re trusted by some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated fleets and insurers.

Our AI-powered platform automates the entire repair lifecycle, from the moment a vehicle needs service until it’s back on the road. By removing bottlenecks, providing real-time visibility, and streamlining decisions, we help customers reduce downtime, control costs, and keep operations running smoothly.

As one of the 100 fastest-growing startups in the United States, and backed by $55M in Series B funding, we're leading this transformation. Join us and help shape the future of vehicle repair.

About the Role:

Service is looking for a highly skilled QA Engineer to join our team remotely. As a core delivery team member, you will be responsible for validating functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring our products meet the highest quality standards. You’ll leverage both a strong QA mindset and technical expertise to support our development teams in building reliable and scalable software solutions.

What You'll Do:

Test Planning & Execution: Decompose product requirements into comprehensive test cases, ensuring full coverage of business and technical needs.
Strategic Testing: Leverage a risk-based approach to determine the optimal balance between manual and automated testing, ensuring a strong focus on user experience, performance, and system reliability.
Debugging & Troubleshooting: Investigate issues by analyzing logs, debugging applications, and identifying root causes of failures.
Database Querying: Write and execute SQL queries to validate data integrity and troubleshoot backend issues.
Automation & CI/CD Alignment: Make informed decisions on what, when, and how to automate, balancing efficiency with development speed.
Defect Management: Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with developers to resolve issues efficiently.
Collaboration & Mentoring: Work within a Scrum team, sharing QA best practices and helping teammates improve testing strategies.

What You'll Bring:

5+ years of experience as a Quality Assurance Engineer, with a strong track record of ensuring software quality in complex systems.
QA Mindset: A keen eye for detail, a passion for delivering quality, and a proactive approach to identifying potential issues before they arise.
Strong Communication: Ability to clearly articulate test findings, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Technical Expertise: Experience debugging applications, analyzing logs, and using developer tools to investigate issues.
Database Proficiency: Ability to write and optimize SQL queries for testing and troubleshooting purposes.
Test Automation Experience: Familiarity with automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools ( e.g., Postman) is a plus.
Agile & CI/CD Familiarity: Understanding of Agile methodologies, version control (e.g., Git), and CI/CD pipelines.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

We live our values every day: Team First, Work Smart, Own It, Be Bold, Push Boundaries. If that sounds like you, you’ll fit right in

What We Offer:

Competitive pay with equity
Medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible PTO and company holidays
Remote-friendly setup with home office support
Learning and development budget
Wellness stipend to support your health and well-being
Paid parental leave

Benefits may vary by location and role.

If you’re motivated by impact and aligned with our values, we want to hear from you. You don’t need to meet every single requirement — we care about your skills, drive, and how you work with a team.

Service Up is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work.

title: QA Automation Engineer
descriptionText:
Location: e123 is a Work From Anywhere company based in southern California with an entirely remote workforce from all over the US. This role can be based anywhere in the US (with the exception of IN, IL, PA, NE).

Why join e123?

e123 is transforming the distribution of health insurance in the United States while creating a new insurtech category. e123 helps businesses manage the complex world of health insurance distribution. We handle $3B in annual premium billings through a network of nearly 400,000 agents. We deliver a single, easy to use platform for clients to distribute and market insurance and benefits products at all levels. We are rapidly expanding our product suite to to address major pain points for enterprise carrier and distribution customers in this market vertical.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to fix a broken system, making it easier and more reliable for millions of people to protect themselves against the unexpected by enabling insurance providers to better match individuals with the right health insurance solutions. This in turn enables accelerating growth for our clients. At e123, we deliver a powerful, widely-used core SaaS product in a premier position central to our industry, and our team knows as much as anyone about the complexities of the United States healthcare insurance distribution network.

Job Description

The QA Automation Engineer is a role on our engineering team focused on test strategy and automation for web applications and REST APIs. You will design, build, and maintain automated test suites; define test strategy across unit, integration, E2E, and API testing; and advocate for quality across the SDLC. You will work alongside product and engineering in an agile workflow, integrate tests into CI/CD, and collaborate with developers on testability, API contracts, and acceptance criteria. Our team uses feature branches and pull requests with code review for all changes, including tests and documentation. Documentation and runbooks live in the repo so specs and test strategy stay easy to find and update.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for web UIs and REST APIs
Define test strategy (unit, integration, E2E, API) and advocate for quality across the SDLC
Integrate tests into CI/CD and monitor stability and coverage
Collaborate with developers on testability, API contracts, and acceptance criteria
Document test approach, flake handling, and automation patterns for the team
Participate in team ceremonies and code review as part of our PR-based workflow

Required Skills & Experience

Experience with Playwright, or adjacent tools (e.g. Cypress, Selenium), for cross-browser E2E tests
Experience with Jest, or similar JavaScript/TypeScript test frameworks, for unit and integration testing
Experience with Postman (collections, environments, CI integration) and/or code-based API tests
Familiarity with OpenAPI and spec-driven or contract testing
Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and interpreting results
Comfort with modern testing patterns (e.g. Page Object–style, data-driven tests, parallel execution, clear reporting)
Critical thinking and problem-solving skills
Demonstrated ability to take initiative and proactively provide solutions
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, rapidly evolving environment
Experience with JIRA or a similar ticketing system is a plus
Experience using AI tooling (e.g. Cursor, Copilot) to author or maintain tests is a plus

*Role : NVMe Test engineer*

*Location : San Jose, CA*

*Duration: 6+ Months*

*Note : *

*- Must have hands-on exp with NVME storage testing*

*- 5 days onsite per week*

*Qualification *

* Strong technical foundation in storage protocols.
* Experience with debugging and troubleshooting technical issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with development teams.

Expected hours: 40 per week

descriptionText:

Sharper Marina Management is a growing B2B SaaS company providing comprehensive marina management software to marina clients nationwide. As our first dedicated and primary QA hire, you'll have the unique opportunity to build our quality assurance function from the ground floor. * Work within our release cycle to ensure quality delivery

* *Ability to work independently *and drive quality initiatives as our first dedicated QA hire
* *Excellent remote work skills *with strong written and verbal communication

*BONUS QUALIFICATIONS*

* *Background in hospitality, travel, or reservations systems *(hotels, RV parks, campgrounds, property management)
* *Familiarity with our tech stack: *PHP, MySQL, Symfony, React, Azure
* Experience testing applications with booking/reservation functionality
* Marina, marine, or recreational industry experience
* *Small company or startup experience *where you've built processes from scratch

We are looking for team members who can build and contribute to our team in ways beyond a direct skill set. We are looking for people who will make us all better!

* *Health Benefits: *Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

Job Overview:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Automation Test Engineer to join our QA team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and executing automated test scripts to ensure the quality and reliability of our software products. This role requires strong technical skills in test automation frameworks, scripting, and continuous integration tools.

Key Responsibilities:

Test Automation Development:

Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
Develop reusable and modular test automation components.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.

Test Planning & Execution:

Collaborate with developers, product managers, and manual testers to understand requirements and define test strategies.
Create and maintain test plans, test cases, and test data for functional, regression, and performance testing.
Execute automated test suites and analyze results to identify defects and ensure product quality.

Defect Management & Reporting:

Log, track, and manage defects using tools like JIRA, Bugzilla, or TestRail.
Work closely with development teams to reproduce, isolate, and resolve issues.
Provide detailed test reports and metrics to stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement:

Stay updated with the latest trends and tools in test automation.
Recommend and implement improvements to enhance test coverage, efficiency, and reliability.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to QA best practices.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
3+ years of experience in test automation and quality assurance.
Proficiency in at least one programming/scripting language: Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#.
Hands-on experience with automation tools like Selenium WebDriver, TestNG, JUnit, Cypress, or Robot Framework.
Experience with API testing using tools like Postman, RestAssured, or SoapUI.
Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with BDD frameworks like Cucumber or SpecFlow.
Exposure to performance testing tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.
Knowledge of cloud-based testing platforms (e.g., BrowserStack, Sauce Labs).
ISTQB or equivalent certification is a plus.

descriptionText:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior QA Engineer with expertise in integration testing retail ecosystems and a strong focus on Logile's Scale Management solutions. This role will be responsible for validating the end-to-end data flow and integration between systems, including LOC, Blue Yonder, FMS, INMAR, Data Lakes, AS400, and store-level scale hardware. The primary objective is to ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of item, pricing, labelling, and weight-related data in a grocery retail environment. Design and execute comprehensive integration test strategies, confirm data flows, synchronise, and fully align with both operational requirements and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute comprehensive integration test plans focused on integration testing for Logile's Scale Management platform, ensuring alignment with corporate pricing, item, and promotional data.
Validate data exchange between Logile and systems such as AS400, LOC, Blue Yonder, FMS, INMAR and Data Lakes.

Experience of working in software development teams and using software QA methodologies and tools

Experience with performance testing will be a bonus

Experience working in an Agile/Scrum product development and support process using JIRA

As a QA Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our HCM and WFM platforms. · Knowledge of API testing tools (e.g., Postman).

401(k)
Health insurance
Paid time off
